cuda_dll_policy.loader: The installed cv2 loader config adds os.path.join(CUDA_PATH, 'bin/x64') for CUDA >= 13, falling back to the toolkit root recorded at configure when CUDA_PATH is unset; at import, cv2/__init__.py passes each path to os.add_dll_directory and prepends it to PATH, which child processes inherit (G0 receipt section 6, row DLL resolution).
cuda_dll_policy.launcher_rule: A worker launcher must set CUDA_PATH to cuda_path_at_build before cv2 is imported and must not inherit the machine value: the CUDA runtime DLLs are named by major version only (cudart64_13.dll), so another 13.x toolkit that moves CUDA_PATH would swap the runtime under the locked artifact.
